runs.question: How much N4 failure is language admission rather than semantics?
runs.hypothesis: Safe explicit language support increases admitted/executed saved programs; semantic success is reported separately.
runs.gate: independent security approval and full truth-free N4 replay bindings
runs.go_no_go: Any safety failure blocks suite; no semantic improvement is claimed from admission alone.

runs.question: Does explicit host-owned toolbox usage avoid wasteful primitive reimplementation?
runs.hypothesis: A concise host-owned callable API with return-shape examples and instructions not to redefine primitives reduces wasteful helper reimplementation. Both arms use the same bounded-v2 language/executor; the detailed control updates N4 instructions to advertise the v2 language rather than claiming immutable N4 prompting.
runs.gate: security review; no prior model run needed
runs.go_no_go: Host arm>=8AST and>=4demo-executed of32; compare query scores separately; reject if only format or cap improvement without semantic evidence.

runs.question: Can typed composition plans trade expressivity for reliable executable proposals?
runs.hypothesis: Strict JSON IR compiles through trusted templates into the same bounded interpreter and reduces code-format burden; declare finite grammar ceiling.
runs.gate: security review and deterministic grammar witness tests; no hidden answers
runs.go_no_go: IR must meet admission gate and show either useful fit/coverage or lower cost; high valid-plan rate alone is insufficient.

runs.question: Do actionable syntax diagnostics repair source-interface failures?
runs.hypothesis: Paired identical initial prompts/seeds; only failed static admission receives generic versus exact node/line/call guidance. Successful static admission resets to fresh root. Demo/query feedback is withheld in both arms.
runs.gate: security approval; intentionally allowed before semantic admission
runs.go_no_go: Increase failed-to-AST transitions and completed demo execution; disclose B0/C0 response mismatch and actual token deltas.

runs.question: Does a deterministic object view make safe program proposals more useful?
runs.hypothesis: Same host-python interface/weights/search; add exact grid shapes,color counts,run lengths and same-color4/8-connected bounding boxes computed from visible inputs and demonstrations.
runs.go_no_go: Keep only if fixed top2 improves without denominator filtering; exact prompt overflow stays excluded. Views have no inferred target or guessed background.

runs.question: Does grounded demonstration feedback improve semantic repair?
runs.hypothesis: Paired root/seed, same syntax diagnostics and parent source; reveal bounded mismatch evidence versus only no-information repair instruction. Four slots and equal caps, actual tokens reported. This is information-value under matched allocation, not exact realized-compute matching.
runs.go_no_go: Report failed-parent-to-demo-fit and final-minus-first selected query exact; no fit-only superiority claim.
runs.causal_limit: Feedback-information and trajectory contrast, not equal-token or single-step causal effect. Preserve identical first-root prompt/seed/response diagnostics.

runs.question: Does bounded best-first repair and duplicate-aware memory outperform fresh breadth?
runs.hypothesis: Same four calls; retain maximum4 candidates, choose best parent using visible fit/execution only, keep deterministic ties and source/behavior novelty summaries. This is a controller package contrast.
runs.go_no_go: Require selected top2 gain or lower cost at same score, disclose exact diversity and repair costs; no cross-task memory.

runs.question: Does a smoothed proposal-derived prior improve fixed-grammar CPU synthesis?
runs.shared_model_pool: 4 typed-IR proposals per task, generated once; identical pool consumed by all three CPU search arms and cost shown once/shared plus per-arm accounting
runs.hypothesis: Smoothed positive-support prior changes search order, uniform is control, zero-support hard pruning is negative control. Same finite candidate language, expansion and wall ceilings.
runs.gate: N7 typed_ir admission receipt; known-witness grammar coverage proof
runs.go_no_go: Report language coverage separately from search efficiency; no claim if all arms have zero fitting candidates.
runs.cpu_deadline_scope: Includes all child startup and verification. Results completed after deadline are ineligible; actual attempted gas charged. Full shared model pool cost charged to every counterfactual standalone arm; physical spend counted once.

runs.question: Can we prepare executor-verified program and repair targets without evaluation-derived generators?
runs.hypothesis: Separate four objectives; fixed authored transform families, family-level split before augmentation, independent query generation, failing mutation and valid repair evidence, exact grammar/witness hashes.
runs.gate: security approval and grammar witness coverage; no ARC source inputs needed
runs.go_no_go: Every exported witness/repair must execute and match synthetic target. Fail closed on family/split overlaps. Produces private offline training payload; does not claim training or quality gains.

runs.question: Does one preregistered selected agent policy beat direct-grid breadth across the32 N3-exposed tasks disjoint from the8 design tasks?
runs.hypothesis: Fixed four candidates per task/arm, one base checkpoint, same frozen task order/seeds; preset selection rule uses prior8-task engineering reports and freezes chosen policy before any generation.
runs.gate: completed qualifying upstream report with>=1top2 task; no winner means BLOCKED, no automatic expensive fallback
runs.go_no_go: Directional selected top2 improvement, report paired task bootstrap and actual costs. Still exposed engineering consolidation;136confirmation untouched, no official score or deployment claim.
